recognize_zh: 左側淋巴組織中可見成群的大型多形性細胞，細胞質豐富、核大且有明顯核仁，部分為多核或怪異核，呈免疫母細胞/漿母細胞樣（immunoblastic/plasmablastic），群聚於竇狀空間；右側為纖維性被膜，符合結外型原發性滲出性淋巴瘤（extracavitary PEL）的組織型態。
features: Clusters and sheets of large pleomorphic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm
Large vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli; occasional multinucleated and bizarre forms
Immunoblastic to plasmablastic appearance, some with eccentric nuclei
Tumor cells aggregate in sinus-like spaces among small lymphocytes
Dense fibrous capsule-like stroma with sparse spindle cells and small lymphoid aggregate at right
describe_en: H&E section of lymphoid tissue shows clusters and sheets of large, pleomorphic neoplastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, large vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, including occasional multinucleated and bizarre forms, arranged in sinus-like spaces among small lymphocytes. The right side of the field shows dense fibrous capsule-like stroma. The cells have an immunoblastic/plasmablastic to anaplastic appearance. Morphology alone is not specific; HHV8 (LANA-1) positivity with loss of B-cell markers is required. Findings are consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma in the context of the case.

ddx.vs: Also sinusoidal with pleomorphic hallmark-like cells, but is HHV8-negative, CD30 strong and usually ALK or T-cell antigen positive with TCR clonality.
Similar plasmablastic cytology and CD20/PAX5 loss, but is HHV8 (LANA-1)-negative and often shows MYC rearrangement.
Cohesive sinusoidal tumor may mimic this; keratin or S100/SOX10 positivity and CD45/MUM1 negativity separate them.
